key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks (Headlines 33, 71)
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations (Headline 39)
AUD weakened sharply on growth scare, amplifying import costs and fuel price pressures (Headlines 45, 31)
Oil prices surged as OPEC+ suppression failed, lifting energy sector but hitting transport/consumer margins (Headlines 47, 31)
ANZ.AX post-3,500-job-cut restructuring faces execution risk under new strategic plan (Headline 22)
RBA flagged rental inflation as a key concern, complicating rate path (Headline 69)
Housing market bifurcating: high-end prices falling sharply while affordable segment shows resilience (Headlines 49, 82)
Mining cap-raise activity surging via Canaccord, signalling capital stress in junior miners (Headline 34)
Australia softened local gas supply rules, easing Asian energy security fears and supporting Santos.AX (Headlines 72, 37)

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; Rio Tinto exiting NT operations; junior miners rushing to raise capital via Canaccord-led deals. Gold miners (Kuniko, Gateway WA) seeing exploration activity but 'gold schmould' sentiment persists.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression on iron ore. Junior miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) show relative strength but cap-raise dilution risk is elevated. Gold names offer partial hedge but lack conviction.

sectors.trend: Negative. Banks tumbling alongside miners as bond yields rise and growth fears build. ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 cuts faces execution uncertainty. Queensland credit rating downgrade adds sovereign risk overlay.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX under pressure from rising funding costs and credit concerns. Qld downgrade (Headline 17) may pressure state-linked lending. RBA rental inflation focus (Headline 69) complicates rate-cut expectations.

sectors.trend: Positive for producers, negative for consumers. Oil surged as suppression failed; Australia softened gas supply rules supporting Santos.AX. Fuel prices set to rise 30c, squeezing transport and ag margins.
sectors.implications: Santos.AX, Woodside.AX benefit from policy support and oil strength. BHP.AX energy division supported. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) face input cost pressure. Diesel spike hits grain farmers (Headline 10).

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths breached its own 'Price Freeze' on staples; women's clothing chain closing 177 stores; businesses broadly fearful. Housing affordability stress constraining discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs and consumer caution. Retail closures signal structural weakness. First-home-buyer surge (Headline 49) may support building/construction names.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-negative. High-end property seeing steepest falls; no spring bounce in auctions. However, affordable segment resilient and first-home buyers surging. RBA rental inflation concern supports rental yields.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) may see rental yield support but capital values under pressure. Housing correction debate (Headlines 79, 80) suggests bifurcated market rather than systemic crash.

sectors.trend: Mixed. Aged care 'crisis' in SA highlights structural underfunding. HIVE/BUZZ HPC AI cloud expansion and ASX small-cap runners (Iondrive, Neurizon) show tech momentum. Critical Resources battery tech passing tests.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX face policy pressure from aged care costs. Small-cap tech (HIVE, Neurizon) offers growth exposure but liquidity risk. Battery tech (Critical Resources) supports EV supply chain theme.

key_themes: Iron ore price deterioration as primary ASX drag
Oil surge creating energy/consumer cost squeeze
AUD weakness amplifying import inflation and rate pressure
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs affordable resilience
Mining sector capital stress and dilution risk
Superannuation reform debate gaining political traction
Energy policy shift supporting domestic gas producers

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore (RIO.AX, FMG.AX); diversify into gold and energy miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation and fuel cost spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour energy producers (SANT.AX, WDS.AX); underweight transport and consumer discretionary

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD weakness and RBA policy uncertainty
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; monitor RBA rental inflation commentary for rate path signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining sector dilution via cap raises
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid junior miners with imminent raises; favour cash-flow-positive majors
Shift REIT exposure to affordable/industrial; avoid luxury residential-linked assets
Review Qld-exposed lending and infrastructure plays; monitor state bond spreads

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian energy producers on oil surge and gas policy support
opportunities.rationale: Oil suppression failure and softened gas supply rules create tailwind for domestic producers; Santos preservation signals policy backing

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold exposure as iron ore hedge
opportunities.rationale: Gold-silver exploration activity (Kuniko, Gateway WA) and safe-haven flows amid growth scare support gold miners despite 'schmould' sentiment

opportunities.recommendation: Add to quality consumer staples on pullback
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths price freeze breach signals pricing power; defensive demand resilient even in softening housing market

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and bank exposure; trim ASX 200 weight
defensive_moves.rationale: $90bn weekly ASX loss driven by miners/banks; iron ore bloodletting and ANZ execution risk create near-term downside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with short AUD or long USD positions
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'smashed' on growth scare; further depreciation likely if RBA cannot resolve rental inflation vs growth dilemma

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid junior miners with pending cap raises
defensive_moves.rationale: Canaccord-led mining capital dash signals dilution risk; PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka show volatility but shareholder dilution looms

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend losses as iron ore weakness, oil-driven inflation, and AUD depreciation compound. RBA rental inflation commentary may delay rate-cut expectations. Expect volatility in miners and banks. Energy and gold relative outperformance likely.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing bifurcation (not systemic crash) supports eventual stabilisation. Energy policy reform and battery tech (Critical Resources) offer structural growth. Superannuation reform debate may create policy tailwind for financials. Iron ore recovery dependent on China demand.

ANZ.AX restructuring progress and cost-out delivery

watch_list: Brent crude and Australian fuel pump prices (+30c expected)
RBA rental inflation data and next statement
ANZ.AX cost-out and strategic plan milestones
Housing auction clearance rates and first-home-buyer data
